app.name: kmdn
app.tagline: Collaborative markdown editing with a git backend.

signin.title: Sign in to {{instance}}
signin.subtitle: Use your work email. There are no passwords to remember.
signin.forgeNote: GitHub and GitLab sign-in only work for accounts already linked to a profile.
signin.checkBody: If {{email}} has an account, we sent a sign-in link. It works once and expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
signin.codeLabel: Or enter the 6-digit code from the email
signin.invalid: This sign-in link or code is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
signin.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

oauthError.no_account: There's no kmdn account for that forge account. Sign in with email, then link it from your profile.
oauthError.expired: The sign-in request expired. Try again.
oauthError.forge: The forge didn't complete the sign-in. Try again.
oauthError.taken: That forge account is linked to another kmdn user.
oauthError.generic: Sign-in with the forge failed. Try again.

signin.passkeyFailed: Signing in with the passkey failed. Try again, or use an email link.

verify.failed: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired.

admin.title: Create the admin account
admin.desc: You'll manage users, repositories and settings. You sign in with email links, so use an address you can receive mail at.
admin.name: Your name
admin.instanceHelp: Shown on the sign-in page and in emails, e.g. Northwind Docs.
admin.missingToken: Open the setup link printed in the kmdn server log. It contains a one-time token.

email.title: Email delivery (SMTP)
email.desc: Required. kmdn signs people in with one-time email links and sends invites. It never sends notification emails.
email.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved password
email.fromHelp: Use an address your mail provider is allowed to send from (SPF/DKIM), or sign-in links may land in spam.
email.locked: SMTP is set in the kmdn config file or environment. Change it there.

forge.title: Connect GitHub or GitLab
forge.desc: After setup, connect repositories from the admin console: create a GitHub App, add a GitLab instance, or paste any git URL.

ai.title: AI provider
ai.desc: The assistant is optional. You can add a provider later in the admin console.

done.title: kmdn is ready
done.desc: Next, connect a repository and invite your team.

shell.publishedHint: You're viewing the published version. Revisions arrive in the next milestone.
shell.revisionsSoon: Revisions arrive in the next milestone
shell.noFiles: No pages in the content root.

home.noReposAdmin: Connect a GitHub or GitLab repository to start editing its markdown.
home.noReposMember: Ask an admin to connect a repository or give you access to one.
home.ask: What do you want to change?
home.askPlaceholder: Describe a change, or ask anything about {{name}}…
home.askHint: The assistant answers, or proposes a revision
home.reviewsDesc: Revisions that asked you to review
home.noMine: You're not in any open revision.

errors.network: Can't reach the kmdn server. Check your connection.
errors.notFound: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

repo.syncingBody: kmdn is fetching the repository for the first time. This usually takes a few seconds.
repo.noActivity: No published changes to pages yet.

file.missing: This file isn't in the published version, or it's outside the repository's content root.
file.viewerHint: You can view and comment. Ask a maintainer for edit access.

settings.title: Settings
settings.adminOnly: Only repository admins can change settings.
settings.generalDesc: Where kmdn reads content and how it publishes.
settings.membersDesc: Roles are managed in kmdn only. Forge permissions are not used.
settings.dangerDesc: These actions affect everyone using this repository in kmdn.
settings.kmdnYml: This repository has a .kmdn.yml. It sets {{fields}}; change those in the repository.
settings.targetBranchHelp: Published is the content of this branch.
settings.contentRootHelp: Only files under this folder appear in kmdn. Leave empty for the whole repository.
settings.selfApproval: Allow maintainers to approve their own revisions
settings.selfApprovalDesc: When off, a maintainer who edited a revision needs another maintainer's approval.
settings.protectionUnknown: kmdn can't read protection rules for this remote.
settings.webhookGit: Send a POST to this URL on every push (e.g. from a git hook or CI) with the token header. kmdn also checks for changes every few minutes.
settings.webhookGitlab: kmdn registered this webhook in GitLab. If it's missing, add it with Push and Merge request events.
settings.noMembers: Nobody has a role yet. Instance admins can always access this repository.
settings.rolesHelp: Viewer: read and comment · Contributor: start revisions, edit when invited · Maintainer: review, approve and publish · Admin: settings and members.
settings.addPlaceholder: Add people or groups by name, or invite by email
settings.resyncDesc: Fetch the latest published content and settings from the forge.
settings.disconnectDesc: Removes {{slug}} from kmdn. The repository on the forge is not touched.
settings.disconnectConfirm: Type {{slug}} to confirm. Members' access to this repository in kmdn is removed.
settings.typeToConfirm: Type the repository name to confirm

profile.title: Your account
profile.desc: How you appear in kmdn and in published commits.
profile.name: Name
profile.commitEmailDesc: Used in the Co-authored-by line when a revision you worked on is published.
profile.linkFirst: Link a GitHub or GitLab account to use its noreply address
profile.customEmailDesc: Any address you can receive mail at
profile.linkedDesc: Sign in with these, and get credit for published changes on the forge.
profile.noProviders: No forge sign-in is configured on this instance.
profile.sessionsDesc: Sign out of devices you don't use anymore.

linkError.taken: That account is already linked to another kmdn user.
linkError.session: Your session changed during linking. Try again.
linkError.forge: The forge didn't complete the sign-in. Try again.
linkError.expired: The link request expired. Try again.

profile.passkeysDesc: Sign in with your device's fingerprint, face or PIN instead of an email link. Passkeys synced by your password manager work on your other devices too.
profile.passkeyAdded: Passkey added. You can sign in with it next time.

invite.invalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired.
invite.title: {{inviter}} invited you to {{instance}}
invite.canRead: Read every page and every revision
invite.canEdit: Start revisions and edit the ones you're invited to
invite.canComment: Comment on pages and suggest changes

admin.title: Admin console
admin.only: Only instance admins can open the admin console.
admin.groupsDesc: Give roles to many people at once.
admin.reposDesc: Connected repositories and the forges they come from.
admin.emailDesc: Used for sign-in links and invites only.
admin.auditDesc: Security-relevant actions on this instance, newest first.
admin.inviteDesc: They get an email with a link to create their account.
admin.addToGroup: Add people by name or email
admin.githubAppDesc: kmdn creates a private GitHub App for this instance. You'll confirm on GitHub, then install it on the accounts whose repositories you want to connect.
admin.gitlabDesc: Repositories on this GitLab connect with a project or group access token, pasted when you connect each one.
admin.gitlabOAuthHint: An OAuth application lets people sign in with their GitLab account and link it, so commits credit them with their GitLab identity. In GitLab, create an application (Admin area → Applications, or a group's Settings → Applications) with this redirect URI, confidential, and the read_user scope; then paste its ID and secret. Leave both empty to skip.
admin.connectDesc: kmdn reads and publishes markdown from this repository.
admin.accessTokenHelp: Scopes api and write_repository, role Developer or higher.
admin.installOnAccount: Install the app on another account
admin.forgeError: Setting up the forge failed ({{code}}). Try again.

revision.unsavedHint: Unsaved changes: Save all commits them to the pull request
revision.unavailable: This page isn't available in the revision

readOnly.viewer: You can view and comment. Ask a maintainer for edit access.
readOnly.not_member: Only the revision's editors ({{editors}}) can change it. Ask one of them to add you.
readOnly.in_review: This revision is in review. Reviewers edit it directly; its editors can comment, or withdraw it to make changes.
readOnly.approved: This revision is approved and waiting to be published.
readOnly.closed: This revision is closed. Reopen it to keep editing.
readOnly.generic: You can't edit this revision right now.

revision.newDesc: A revision collects changes to one or more pages. Nothing is published until it's reviewed.
revision.reviewSoon: Review and publishing arrive in the next milestone.
revision.addPageDesc: Creates a new page in this revision. It's published with the rest of the revision.
revision.noChangesHint: Open any page and start typing, or add a new page.
revision.renameDesc: Pages that link here can be updated in the same revision.
revision.addEditor: Add an editor by name or email

events.approvals_reset: Approvals were reset by a change
events.publishing: turned on auto-merge: the forge merges once its checks pass
events.change_request_closed: The pull request was closed without merging
events.change_request_opened: Opened its pull request on the forge
events.update_available: Published changed pages in this revision

revision.linksOk: All links in this revision work.
revision.breaksInbound: links to {{target}}, which this revision removes
revision.hasConflicts: has conflicts with Published to resolve
revision.phoneReadOnly: Editing works on tablets and computers.

checkpoints.title: Checkpoints
checkpoints.name: Checkpoint name
checkpoints.namePlaceholder: Describe what changed (optional), e.g. Ready for legal
checkpoints.restored: Restored. Save all to commit it; any unsaved work was saved first.
checkpoints.none: No checkpoints yet. Each Save all commits the revision to its pull request and shows up here.
checkpoints.viewDesc: The revision's pages as they were at this checkpoint.

links.unavailable: Links aren't available for this page.

review.nowApproved: Approved by every reviewer. Ready to publish.
review.submitDesc: Reviewers edit and approve in the editor. Every reviewer must approve before it can be published.
review.noCandidates: No maintainers can review this revision. Ask an admin to add one.
review.brokenLinksWarning_one: {{count}} broken link. You can still submit.
review.brokenLinksWarning_other: {{count}} broken links. You can still submit.
review.requestChangesDesc: The revision goes back to its editors with your note. Approvals are reset.
review.title: Review summary
review.writing: The assistant is reading the changes…
review.none: No summary yet. One is written when the revision is sent for review.
review.fixAsked: Asked the assistant: its suggestions will appear in the page

publish.title: Publish to {{branch}}
publish.desc: kmdn merges the revision's pull request with a merge commit, co-signed by the people who wrote it. Every saved commit stays in the history.
publish.assisted: Parts were written with the assistant.
publish.protected: {{branch}} is protected: kmdn merges through the forge. If checks are required, the forge merges once they pass.
publish.requiredReviews_one: Branch protection requires an approval on the forge, which kmdn can't give. Add kmdn to the rule's bypass list, or approve the pull request there.
publish.requiredReviews_other: Branch protection requires {{count}} approvals on the forge, which kmdn can't give. Add kmdn to the rule's bypass list, or approve the pull request there.
publish.waitingForMerge: Waiting for the forge's required checks: it merges the pull request once they pass.

blocked.not_approved: Every reviewer has to approve first.
blocked.updates_pending: Apply the updates from Published first.
blocked.other: This revision can't be published right now.
blocked.suggestions_pending: Accept or reject the pending suggestions first.

diff.noChanges: No changes to this page yet.

comments.emptyHint: Select text and click Comment to start a thread.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.toggleHint: Record your edits as suggestions others can accept or reject
suggestions.refused: This change can't be made as a suggestion yet. Turn off Suggesting to make it directly.
suggestions.toAddressHint: Accept or reject each one: approval and publishing wait until none are pending.
suggestions.blocking_one: {{count}} pending suggestion: accept or reject it before approving
suggestions.blocking_other: {{count}} pending suggestions: accept or reject them before approving
suggestions.sourceLocked_one: This page has {{count}} pending suggestion. Accept or reject it in the visual editor to edit the source.
suggestions.sourceLocked_other: This page has {{count}} pending suggestions. Accept or reject them in the visual editor to edit the source.
suggestions.announceAssistant: New suggestion from the assistant for {{name}}

updates.banner_one: Published changed {{count}} page in this revision
updates.banner_other: Published changed {{count}} pages in this revision

updates.noteConflicts: Applying saves a checkpoint first and resets approvals. Conflicts show both versions in the page, and a revision in review goes back to Editing until they're resolved.
updates.appliedConflicts_one: Updates applied with {{count}} conflict to resolve
updates.appliedConflicts_other: Updates applied with {{count}} conflicts to resolve
updates.waitEditors: An editor of this revision applies them.
updates.pages_one: {{count}} page of this revision changed on Published.
updates.pages_other: {{count}} pages of this revision changed on Published.

conflict.title: Conflict with Published
conflict.pageDeleted: Published deleted this page after the revision started changing it.

kinds.approved: Every reviewer approved: ready to publish
kinds.update_available: Published changed pages in this revision
kinds.conflicts: Updates from Published brought {{conflicts}} conflicts: back to editing
kinds.publishing: A pull request was opened to publish it
kinds.publish_closed: The pull request was closed without merging

prefs.hint: People involved in a revision hear about it here and, if you allow it, as browser notifications. No emails.

prefKinds.reply: A reply in a thread you're in
prefKinds.publishing: A pull request opens to publish
prefKinds.published: A revision you're in is published
prefKinds.publish_closed: A publish pull request is closed
prefKinds.page_published: A page you follow is updated

follow.hint: Get an inbox item when a revision changing this page is published
follow.auto: You edited this page recently, so you follow it for a while
follow.updated: Updated {{date}} by {{people}} since your last visit
follow.noVisibleChange: Nothing visible changed on the page.

hooks.title: Webhooks
hooks.desc: Send revision and discussion events to Slack or your own tools. Deliveries are retried for 24 hours.

kindHelp.slack: Paste a Slack Incoming Webhook URL: kmdn posts formatted messages to its channel.
kindHelp.generic: kmdn POSTs JSON signed with a secret (X-Kmdn-Signature: sha256=…).

hooks.secretOnce: Save the signing secret: it won't be shown again.
hooks.secretHint: Check X-Kmdn-Signature: the HMAC-SHA256 of the body with this secret.

ai.title: AI provider
ai.desc: The assistant, review summaries and consistency checks use this model provider. Keys are stored encrypted.
ai.disabledByConfig: The assistant is turned off in the server configuration (assistant.enabled: false).
ai.managedByConfig: The provider, API key and models are set in the server configuration (KMDN_ASSISTANT_* variables). Change them there and restart kmdn; budgets and scan settings below can still be changed here.
ai.keySet: A key is set: type to replace it
ai.budgetHint: 0 means no limit. Budgets count input, output and cached tokens.
ai.consistencyHint: Finds contradictions and duplicate text across pages. Needs an OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint (Anthropic has none); pairs are judged with the titles and short text model.
ai.embeddingsManaged: The embeddings endpoint is set in the server configuration (KMDN_ASSISTANT_EMBEDDINGS_* variables).

assistant.off: The assistant isn't set up on this instance.
assistant.offAdmin: The assistant isn't set up yet. Connect an AI provider in Admin → AI provider.
assistant.intro: Ask about this repository's pages. Answers cite their sources; ask for a change and I'll propose a revision.
assistant.queued: Queued: the assistant answers after the current reply
assistant.movesNotice: This conversation moves into the revision, where its collaborators can see it.
assistant.introRevision: Ask the assistant to change this revision's pages: its edits are suggestions to accept or reject.
assistant.readOnly: Only people who can edit this revision can ask the assistant here.

consistency.title: Consistency
consistency.intro: Places where pages say the same thing twice or say contradicting things. Advisory: nothing is blocked.
consistency.capped: The scan stopped at its limit of model calls; the next one picks up where it left off.
consistency.off: Consistency checks aren't set up on this instance.
consistency.offAdmin: Consistency checks need an AI provider and an embeddings model: set them up in Admin → AI provider.
consistency.ignoreDesc: Say why this is fine. The pair stays ignored in every revision and scan until one of the passages changes.
consistency.reasonPlaceholder: The FAQ repeats the policy on purpose.
consistency.asked: The assistant is on it in the revision's thread.
consistency.publishNote_one: {{count}} consistency finding is open. Advisory: you can publish anyway.
consistency.publishNote_other: {{count}} consistency findings are open. Advisory: you can publish anyway.

agentKeys.title: Agent keys
agentKeys.desc: Keys for external agents (Claude Code, support bots…) to search and read published docs over MCP. Read-only; each key sees the repositories you pick. Endpoint:
agentKeys.createDesc: The key is shown once. Agents send it as a bearer token.
agentKeys.name: Name
agentKeys.onceWarning: Copy the key now: it won't be shown again. Anyone with it can read these repositories' published docs.
agentKeys.none: No agent keys yet. Create one to let an external agent read published docs.
agentKeys.revokeDesc: Agents using this key lose access right away. This can't be undone; create a new key if you need one.

system.title: System
system.desc: This instance's version, database and background jobs, and the doctor's checks.
system.doctorDesc: Checks git, the data directory, the database, the secret key, SMTP, forges and the AI provider (same as kmdn doctor).
